responsibility: Implements synthesis of the builtin `unsafe` package within the Go frontend, creating its package object, `Pointer` type, and declarations for builtins such as `Sizeof`, `Offsetof`, `Alignof`, `Add`, and `Slice`. It integrates `unsafe` into the imported-package table, marks visibility and dot-import behavior, and triggers the backend-facing `go_imported_unsafe` notification the first time the package is brought in.
